versions.content: The role of PortPrototype s in the AUTOSAR architecture A PortPrototype mainly contributes the functionality of being a connection point to the AUTOSAR concept. The details, i.e. with respect to what kind of information is actually transported between two PortPrototype s is defined by the PortInterface .
